body:
Merge seat, ADR-76 re-assessment:
- #2598 BUG-1962 does NOT qualify. It changes runaway_seats.rs (the watchdog, STRICT tier), so its surviving mutations still block. It stays with agy.
- #2600 TASK-1740 does NOT qualify. It carries #2599's rejected credential commits and adds a flaky test to the default suite. It stays with agy.
- #2603 BUG-1995: REQUEST CHANGES at 487a66f676. All 3 blockers are small and test-only (coverage loss on the forge timeout, an unsafe kill -9 in Fixture Drop, the orphaned worker from the spec's acceptance), so FIX-FORWARD is claimed.
- Every reviewer prompt from now on carries the ADR-76 tier text.
subject: Merge seat: ADR-76 re-assessment of #2598/#2600, #2603 fix-forward
